issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at module import is a hack you flagged yourself
issues.detail: You wrote 'Temporary hack' in the comment. That means it's not temporary, it's shipped. You're reaching into a private underscore-prefixed attribute of a third-party library at import time, mutating global state for every consumer of pipecat that imports this module. File a bug upstream, pin the version, or pass the buffer size through a supported API. BAD-TASTE.

issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' will break for any PNG with alpha or palette mode
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNG. PIL opens it in whatever mode the file is in (RGBA, P, L). You call tobytes() without converting and declare format='RGB'. The downstream consumer will get a buffer of the wrong size and wrong layout. Either image.convert('RGB').tobytes() or honor the actual mode. This will crash or render garbage in production.

issues.description: Changing the default model from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent breaking change buried in a feature PR
issues.detail: THREE-PATCHES. One PR adds image support. A separate PR bumps the default model. Users who didn't pin the model now get different pricing, different latency, different behavior on their next deploy. The CHANGELOG mentions it but it doesn't belong in the same patch as the image generation feature.

issues.description: Image detection by substring match on model name is fragile
issues.detail: 'if "image" in self._model_name' will match any future model with 'image' anywhere in its name, including ones that aren't image-generation models. Same shape problem as the existing startswith check above it. A capability registry or explicit flag would be the right shape; substring sniffing is BAD-TASTE that will bite when Google ships gemini-X-image-understanding.

issues.description: No error handling around Image.open of arbitrary server-returned bytes
issues.detail: If the model returns malformed inline_data, PIL raises UnidentifiedImageError and the entire context-processing loop dies. At minimum wrap in try/except, log the failure, and continue processing remaining parts. A streaming pipeline that aborts on one bad image part is hostile to the operator.

issues.description: Gratuitous blank line added in __init__ with no other change nearby
issues.detail: Line 717 inserts a blank line between self._http_options assignment and self._create_client. Doesn't match the surrounding style and adds noise to the diff. Drop it. Style nit, but the diff should only contain what the patch needs.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The feature is small and the shape is roughly right, but two real bugs ship with it: a self-described "temporary hack" that monkey-patches a private attribute of google-genai at import time, and an Image.tobytes() call that declares RGB while accepting whatever mode PIL happens to decode. The default-model bump is a separate patch masquerading as part of this one. Fix the image conversion, find a non-hack way to set the buffer size or pin the dep, split the model-default change, and replace the substring sniff with something that won't lie when Google ships another model with "image" in the name.
